name: Publish resident owners before native namespace loads
intent: Build the approved host-side namespace-sharing experiment without duplicating runtime owners or replacing r3 permissions.
must: Build only the host adapter unit on byte-reproduced r3 65cc3535; reuse frozen stock objects unchanged.
Do not operate devices, take locks, modify U10.1/T8 or create an executable observation window.
Keep resident-compat, INET, existing native default/private permissions, service layouts and unchanged SoundPool policy0718.
Only exact canonical bridge/runtime requests may use resident sealed handles; missing owners reject, never fresh-load or default-fallback.
Existing same-parent permissions must be merged once, not overwritten with a second inherit.
Raw static/ABI/N1/N2 findings remain visible; new manifest-bound exceptions require outer approval.
decisions: Bridge and app owner publication precedes fresh loads; original private owner permissions merge into their single sealed edge.
Ordinary compat from the same sealed parent merges into that same edge; verified default compat retains its separate original edge.
Exact paths use sealed NOLOAD handles, aliases and missing owners reject, non-owner requests retain the old callback.
Static may-path findings are compared individually with r3, not silently waived as runtime safety.
out_of_scope: No dynamic single-owner, white-window, t20 or screenshot acceptance.
No self-approved exception or executable window.

completion_criteria.name: Original permissions survive once-only owner publication

steps.text: The actual candidate callbacks and OH-style replacement inheritance semantics
Ordinary, native-private and Flutter domains plus sealed/default compat choices replay
Both owner edges precede fresh loads, original paths and permissions survive, and no parent edge is inherited twice

completion_criteria.name: Protected paths do not create fresh owners

Only canonical owners return sealed NOLOAD handles, failure rejects without fallback, and non-owner routing and guards remain intact

completion_criteria.name: Final artifact audits retain all unapproved findings

steps.text: Byte-reproduced r3, two identical candidates and explicit package checks
Open-site, strings, ABI/calls/consumer and N1/N2 run offline
Inherit-repeat is zero, r3 after-open changes are enumerated, structural identity survives and unapproved findings remain blockers
